status: development-passed frozen model specification; final holdout not yet evaluated; no version assigned
discoveryMethod: Mine repeated JRA market mispricing structures from the development period first, require each retained distortion rule to exceed 200% ROI in all three development subperiods with minimum support, then generalize the frozen rules to pre-race ticket and race selection.
commonTicketRanking: stable-rule matches first; among matches sort by conservative rule score (minimum ROI across the three development subperiods), then rule match count, then pre-race direct-model score/EV; if no stable match exists use the fixed pre-race direct score/EV fallback

ライト.raceSelection: exactly five per raceDate x venue; rank races by third-best stable quinella rule score, then best stable quinella score, then fixed pre-race quinella EV

スタンダード.raceSelection: exactly five per raceDate x venue; rank races by max(best stable quinella rule score, best stable exacta rule score, best stable trio rule score)

プレミアム.raceSelection: exactly five per raceDate x venue; rank races by max(best stable quinella rule score, best stable exacta rule score, best stable trio rule score, best stable trifecta rule score)

holdoutRule: No model, rule, race-selection formula, stake allocation, threshold, or tie-breaking logic may be changed after final holdout outcomes are inspected. Only this frozen specification may be evaluated on dateIndex >= 216.
